title: Puzzle 3d Reference Inspector Details
description: Show all reference transform information (position, rotation, tilt, scale in all directions, etc.) in the puzzle 3d details/inspector panel when a reference is selected.
summary: Fixed reference selection: introduced worldEntityInspectable (hidden blocks pick, locked still selectable for details). PuzzleReferences and WorldReferencePlaneItem use inspectable for pick/hover/selection outline; gumball still requires unlock. filterSelectionByPlaygroundKinds keeps locked references, drops hidden only. raycastHitTargetsPick recognizes worldReferenceId so clicks do not clear selection. commitSelection accepts click modifiers. Play tests 76/76 pass.
